headline: Aniimo multiplayer: Egg Heist, RV and Homeland
title: Aniimo Multiplayer Explained | Egg Heist PvP, RV Camp and Homeland
video_script: Aniimo is not just a solo adventure. In the Egg Heist mode, you join a team of three and battle other players in real time across the Lost Isles. Stuck on a tough fight? Blow the Horn to call other players for help, or use the Flute to invite them over. Every Pathfinder also gets a personal RV parked at a campsite, and back in your Homeland you can plant crops, build decorations and hang out with your Aniimo. Solo or squad? Comment below!
description: Aniimo multiplayer explained: Egg Heist (3-player team PvEvP in the Lost Isles), the Horn and Flute co-op tools, your personal RV campsite, and the Homeland where you farm, decorate and live with your Aniimo.
